Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.section1Body: EPUB Converter (epubmaker.vercel.app) is a service that converts documents (e.g. DOCX, TXT) to EPUB format. It is operated by an individual developer. By signing up (via email or Google OAuth) and using the service, you agree to these Terms. The service is provided "as is" and you use it at your own responsibility.
Terms.section2Body: You may not: (a) use the service for any illegal purpose or to violate any laws; (b) upload content that infringes others' intellectual property or that you do not have rights to; (c) attempt to reverse engineer, overload, or disrupt the service or its infrastructure; (d) resell or redistribute the service without permission; (e) use automated means to abuse the service beyond normal use.
Terms.section3Body: We may change, limit, or discontinue the service or these Terms at any time. We will try to give notice of material changes where feasible (e.g. on the site or by email). Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance. We are not liable for any modification, suspension, or discontinuation of the service.
Terms.section4Body: The service is provided without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation. We are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the service or from conversion results. You are responsible for backing up your data and for how you use converted files.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.section1Body: We collect: (a) Account data: email address, and if you sign up with Google, your Google profile information (e.g. name, profile picture) provided by Google; (b) Payment-related data: processed by Lemon Squeezy (payment provider)—we do not store full payment card details; (c) Usage data: conversion history, file metadata, and IP address for abuse prevention; (d) Error reports: if you encounter errors, we may send anonymized data to Sentry for debugging.
Privacy.section2Body: We use this information to: provide and operate the service; manage your account and subscriptions; process payments via Lemon Squeezy; prevent abuse and enforce our terms; improve the service and fix errors; and, where applicable, send you service-related or marketing communications if you have opted in.
Privacy.section3Body: We retain account and conversion data while your account is active and as needed for legal or operational purposes. After account deletion, we delete or anonymize your data within a reasonable period, except where we must retain it for law or dispute resolution.
Privacy.section4Body: We use: Supabase (hosting and database) for authentication and storing your account and conversion data; Lemon Squeezy for payment processing—their privacy policy applies to payment data; Sentry for error monitoring. These providers may process data in accordance with their own policies. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.
Privacy.section5Body: You may access, correct, or delete your account and associated data through the account settings. You can request a copy of your data or account deletion. For payment or subscription issues, you can also use the Lemon Squeezy customer portal or contact their support.
Privacy.section6Body: For privacy-related questions or requests, contact us via the contact method provided on epubmaker.vercel.app (e.g. contact form or email listed on the site).

Refund.title: Refund Policy
Refund.section1Body: Subscriptions are billed through Lemon Squeezy. You may cancel your subscription at any time from the subscription management (billing portal) or your Lemon Squeezy account. Refunds for subscription payments are handled according to Lemon Squeezy's policy: typically, you may request a refund within a short period after charge (e.g. as stated on the checkout or in Lemon Squeezy's terms). Beyond that, we do not guarantee refunds for partial months or unused periods.
Refund.section2Body: For one-time pay-per-use (e.g. per-conversion) purchases, refunds may be considered if the conversion clearly failed due to a service error (e.g. server-side failure, incorrect output). Refunds are not provided for user error (e.g. wrong file, wrong settings). Request a refund by contacting us with your order or conversion details.
Refund.section3Body: Refund requests should be sent via the contact method on epubmaker.vercel.app. We will respond within a reasonable time (e.g. within 14 business days). Approved refunds will be processed via Lemon Squeezy; the time to appear on your statement depends on your bank or card issuer.
